name: Maintained normally-closed contact
summary: A maintained NC contact retains its actuated position until the documented return action occurs.
description: A maintained NC contact retains its actuated position until the documented return action occurs. The unactuated closed state and retained operated state must both be understood.
readingNotes: Trace the specified reset action before evaluating the next operating cycle.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A maintained contact is not necessarily an electrically latching relay.
